caption: The drawing depicts a lidded container, possibly a sugar bowl or similar vessel, with two ornate handles. The container is primarily white or light gray in color, with gold accents outlining the top rim, the bottom border, and the handles. The lid is topped with a decorative gold knot or leaf-like finial, and a gold stripe runs horizontally around the upper portion of the body. The handles are symmetrical, with curling designs and gold highlights. The shadowing and highlights suggest a glossy surface. The background is plain and beige, and the name "Stewart" appears in small letters toward the bottom right in brownish-gold ink.
title: Sugar Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
